comparison.objective: PR-1562 makes a copper-pipe compression joint; the candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1562 tests ordering an olive and nut, seating pipe, finding snug, and tightening with a spanner; the candidate tests coaxial driver seating plus simultaneous jam-nut counterholding to prevent setting drift.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1562 requires pipe home, olive captured, and nut 3/4–1 1/4 turns past calibrated snug without over-compression; the candidate requires a retained 90° angle after three actuation cycles.
comparison.reason: This is a close threaded-tool neighbor, but controlled compression-joint makeup neither preserves an independent screw setting nor verifies articulated travel.
